notes: Each case runs frmMain's own FilterSpells / FilterMonsters (cut out by tools/oracle/frm.py) against a subset of the stock database (db_only). The lists are recording ListViews read before the sort that follows. A spell row is its number; a monster row is its number and a tag with the arguments that differ from AddMonster2LV's defaults (d,e,r,s,m,c,f,n,x) and the profile's HP (h) and HP regen (g) when the filter changed them. Cases with bRealAdd go on to the real AddMonster2LV.

Stubbed: LV_RefreshSort / LV_Sort_ColumnClick, the *_ItemClick handlers, RefreshExtraMonsterFilterButton, RefreshMonsterColors, the picture loads. optMonsterFilter_Click only runs SetCurrentAttackTypeConfig (as RefreshMonsterCombatGUI does first). ReachIsMonsterOK is scripted (multiples of 7 are out of reach below level 30). A Yes to the damage questions is counted (recalc, recalc_party), not run.
